blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution urged Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday to personally explain the discrepancies between what she declared in her statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALNs) and her substantial bank balances, allegedly undeclared properties, and business interests as they appeared in other financial documents. Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr., a spokesman and counsel for the prosecution, renewed the call in a statement urging Duterte to take the witness stand, as she would be in the best position to explain apparent discrepancies. According to the prosecution statement, records presented before the Senate impeachment court showed that Duterte did […]...
